messages:
Judy: Heads up - XCorp requested tenant-level SIEM exports of audit logs for 90 days. They need KMS envelope IDs in exports (not keys). Can we support? :thinking:
Sam: There's an audit_streams.visibility flag but legal gating for PII. Is this tenant- or project-level scope?
Judy: Tenant-level. Only auth/audit events (authn, token issuance, role changes, key-access). No prompt contents. NDA in place but legal wants a brief runbook + data handling proof.
Elaine: Feasible. We'll redact prompt blobs and add envelope_id to audit schema. Need to ensure no key material flows.
Sam: Our current pipeline logs key_id but not envelope_id. Adding envelope_id to schema is low-risk.
Mike: Can we make this opt-in per-tenant? Revops needs a cost estimate for retention/egress.
Judy: Yes, opt-in with DPA amendment. Also need a security review call and attestation about on-prem customers not receiving cross-tenant data.
sec-bot: INCIDENT-TRACE: feature flag audit_streams.visibility toggled in staging at 1768765500 by Sam. CI build#7321 succeeded.
Sam: Proposed rollout: 1) schema change (envelope_id:string, redact prompt_blob). 2) tenant opt-in flag. 3) legal signoff + DPA amendment. 4) 2-week staging canary -> limited prod -> enable for XCorp.
Elaine: Forwarder changes: call KMS metadata API to get envelope_id at write time and null prompt_blob. Pseudocode:
```
entry = {event, user, metadata}
entry.metadata.envelope_id = kms.getEnvelopeId(key_handle)
entry.metadata.prompt_blob = null
emit(entry)
```
Add unit tests to assert redaction.
Judy: Security will produce an evidence packet with redacted log samples, rotation history, and SIEM ingest config.
Sam: ETA: schema + forwarder changes by EOW if no blockers. I'll write a short design doc and a PR (INF-4821).
Mike: I'll estimate cost: added S3 retention + egress. Also ensure export buckets have tenant isolation labels.
Judy: Quick sync with legal & CS Wednesday 10am PT. @Sam @Elaine @Mike?
Elaine: I'll demo staging redaction and envelope_id. 
Sam: I'll create the feature-flag toggles and PR. Ticket INF-4821.
sec-bot: Deploy: PR 7890 merged to staging at 1768765801. Canary started for tenant:xcorp-canary.
Elaine: Staging sample (redacted): {"ts":"1768765790","event":"role.change","user":"u-234","metadata":{"envelope_id":"env_83a1b","prompt_blob":null}}
Mike: Cost estimate added to INF-4821: +$120/mo for 90d retention at current volume.
Judy: Noted. I'll draft the customer response and legal runbook. Keep this thread as the evidence trail. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Links: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4821
Judy: Closing for now, will follow up after legal call. DM or ping #eng-security if anything urgent.
